audit.corrected: phases[4].why now says Jayce has no level-6 spike and describes R as the free 6s swap it is. Shock Blast's 16s at rank 1 and Thundering Blow's 20s written into early.

audit.whatIsWrong: The armour and magic-resist shred on Mercury Cannon's first attack was never mentioned anywhere, and neither was the fact that the stance swap functions as an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot's R text: 'The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.' That shred is what makes his follow-up poke hurt more than the raw numbers suggest, and the swap animation is the only tell you get before the burst — not a cast bar.
audit.corrected: early now names the Mercury Cannon shred and points at the swap animation as the step-back cue.

notes: Chart rebuilt to the mirror, which also matches this page's own whys — the published version handed Jayce first item and 2+ items in a matchup whose own text calls him 'a lane-bully who falls off'. Separately, phases[4].why claimed a Jayce level-6 ultimate spike; his R is a no-cost 6s stance swap available from level 1, so that line described a spike that does not exist. The mirror's note is worth repeating: the generic 'Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only' template line in loading, breakdown.cooldowns and the Common Mistakes report line reads ambiguously on a Jayce page, since it is meant to describe Cannon Barrage but sits next to Jayce's R. I left those alone since they are Gangplank-side statements, but the ambiguity is real and probably repeats across every Jayce matchup in the repo.
